description: This file defines the TorchScriptIrBuilder class, which extends the IrBuilder to create various nodes (e.g., device data, tensor operations, shape manipulation) specific to the TorchScript backend in PyTorch's lazy evaluation framework. It includes method definitions for creating different IR nodes and references several internal headers related to lazy tensor computation.

classes.name: TorchScriptIrBuilder
classes.description: A specialized IR builder for the TorchScript backend, providing methods to create various IR nodes used in lazy tensor operations within the TorchScript runtime.

methods.name: NodePtr MakeDeviceData(const std::shared_ptr<BackendData> & data) const
methods.description: Creates a device data node from the provided backend data.

methods.name: NodePtr MakeScalar(const at::Scalar & value,const at::ScalarType & type) const
methods.description: Creates a scalar node with a given value and type. Note that scalars are currently not used by the ts_backend.

methods.name: NodePtr MakeExpand(const Value & input0,const std::vector<int64_t> & size,const bool & is_scalar_expand) const
methods.description: Creates an expand node for tensor shape broadcasting.

methods.name: NodePtr MakeCast(const Value & input0,const at::ScalarType & dtype,const std::optional<at::ScalarType> & stype=std::nullopt) const
methods.description: Creates a cast node to change tensor data type.

methods.name: NodePtr MakeTensorList(const OpList & inputs) const
methods.description: Creates a tensor list node from a list of operations.

methods.name: NodePtr MakeGeneric(const OpKind & op,const OpList & operands,const Shape & shape,const size_t & num_outputs=1,const hash_t & hash_seed=static_cast<uint32_t> (0x5a2d296e9)) const
methods.description: Creates a generic IR node for an arbitrary operation with operands and shape info.

methods.name: NodePtr MakeSizeNode(const Value & input,size_t dim) const
methods.description: Creates a node representing the size of a tensor along a given dimension.

methods.name: NodePtr MakeSizeAdd(const Value & a,const Value & b) const
methods.description: Creates a node representing the addition of two size nodes.

methods.name: NodePtr MakeSizeMul(const Value & a,const Value & b) const
methods.description: Creates a node representing the multiplication of two size nodes.

methods.name: NodePtr MakeSizeDiv(const Value & a,const Value & b) const
methods.description: Creates a node representing the division of two size nodes.
